title: tithymalus andrachnoides
intro: Tithymalus andrachnoides, commonly known as the Andrachne glandulosa or Gondavana, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Tithymalus andrachnoides are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
